children: Consumer discretionary stocks continue to attract investor attention as spending patterns, travel demand, automotive trends and retail activity shape the outlook across the sector.
With valuations varying across subsectors, companies trading at discounts to their underlying fundamentals can stand out for investors seeking relatively attractive opportunities.

Below is a list of the top eight consumer discretionary stocks ranked by their quantitative Valuation Grade. The stocks are arranged according to their valuation grade rankings, highlighting companies that compare favorably on measures used to assess how expensive or inexpensive they are relative to their fundamentals.
The list is led by Callaway Golf Company
, all of which carry an A Valuation Grade. Bath & Body Works, Inc.
follow with A- grades, rounding out the screen of highly rated consumer discretionary names.

The Seeking Alpha Valuation Grade indicates how expensive a stock is relative to its fundamentals, with A+ representing the most undervalued end of the scale and F representing the most overvalued, or pricey, end.
